# Getting help with Teampass

Different questions go to different places. Here is the routing.

## 📖 Start with the documentation

Most questions are already answered at **[documentation.teampass.net](https://documentation.teampass.net)**.

| | |
|---|---|
| Installing for the first time | [Installation guide](https://documentation.teampass.net/#/install/installation) |
| Moving between versions | [Upgrade guide](https://documentation.teampass.net/#/install/upgrade) |
| Permission or file-access errors | [File permissions](https://documentation.teampass.net/#/install/file-permissions) |
| Something is broken | [Troubleshooting](https://documentation.teampass.net/#/misc/troubleshooting) |
| Hardening a production install | [Security hardening](https://documentation.teampass.net/#/install/security-hardening) |
| Using the API | [API reference](https://documentation.teampass.net/#/api/api-basic) |

## 💬 Questions, advice, ideas

**[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/nilsteampassnet/TeamPass/discussions)** — the right place
for "how do I…", deployment advice, configuration questions and feature ideas.

Please do not open issues for questions — they get lost among the bug reports and answered more
slowly.

## 🐛 Bugs

**[Open an issue](https://github.com/nilsteampassnet/TeamPass/issues/new/choose)**.

To get a useful answer on the first reply, include:

- the steps to reproduce, and what you expected instead
- your Teampass version, PHP version, database and web server
- the relevant part of the PHP error log
- the diagnostic report from **Admin → Bug icon (bottom left)**

## 🔒 Security vulnerabilities

**Never in a public issue.** Use
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/nilsteampassnet/TeamPass/security/advisories/new).
Full policy: [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

## 💼 Commercial support

Teampass is maintained by one person. Community support is best-effort and free; paid options
exist when you need a commitment:

- **Pro Extension** — browser autofill and capture, includes email support
- **Services** — feature development, deployment assistance, priority handling

See **[teampass.net/pricing.html](https://teampass.net/pricing.html)**, or write to
**nils@teampass.net**.

## ❤️ Supporting the project

Free support is funded by people who sponsor the work. If Teampass is useful to you or your
company, consider [sponsoring it](https://github.com/sponsors/nilsteampassnet).
